# Trident Automation Systems

> Professional fire safety, security systems, and surveillance solutions provider serving Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi with installation, AMC, and compliance services.

Trident Automation Systems (Trident Autosys) specializes in fire alarm systems, CCTV surveillance, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems, and annual maintenance contracts for commercial, industrial, and warehouse facilities across India. The company provides FSAI-compliant fire safety solutions, IP and analog CCTV systems, interactive smart boards, and comprehensive building safety services.
